annotations.title: Buy a Gemmein plan (your human pays)

description: Free to build. You pay when an app goes live — or buy ahead if you're ready. Hands your human Gemmein's own payment page for the ACCOUNT's plan, before this app goes live (one plan covers every app on the account — Launch — $29 a month for the account, up to 5 apps — any may go live. 50 GB pooled storage.; Run a business — $79 a month for the account, up to 10 apps — any may go live. 200 GB pooled storage.; Grow — $199 a month for the account, up to 25 apps — any may go live. 500 GB pooled storage.; Annual billing on every paid tier: 2 months off, save 17% (Launch $290, Run a business $790, Grow $1,990 a year). Above 25 apps is Beyond: there's no checkout for it — your human talks to us at hello@gemmein.com. Nothing was set up.). They sign in, see the plan you named already picked — they can pick another tier or yearly there — and pay in Stripe's window. The plan then belongs to the ACCOUNT and billing starts at once, covering every app on it; this app is NOT taken live by it, and going live later (for this or any other app on the account) is only their approval (request_go_live), with no payment step. Paying is your human's act; this tool changes nothing itself. Answers state: waiting (the link — send it, then call buy_plan again with wait: 40 straight away, and again while it says waiting; it answers the moment they pay, or that the page was closed, expired or revoked (this connection disconnected) — never ask your human to tell you when they've paid), paid or already_paid (what the account owns), already_live (tier changes are your human's, in Stripe's billing portal from Settings → Usage & billing), or refused (why, with the fix). Calling again reuses the same page. Opened from the app this connection is for, but pays for the whole account's plan. This is what a founder may call paying for Gemmein, buying a plan or subscribing.

interval.description: default month; yearly is two months off

tier.description: the plan to suggest (default launch); beyond is a conversation with Gemmein, never a checkout

wait.description: 0–40: wait up to this many seconds for your human to pay
